text: {"lessons":["Past price changes do not predict future prices, so I should avoid treating recent moves as reliable signals.","Selling Stock B after a large gain and Stock C after a small gain felt satisfying, but I should base future sell decisions on my plan rather than the pleasure of locking in gains.","My account fell despite those sales; I should assess the whole portfolio and avoid letting reluctance to admit a mistake or pain from a loss dictate whether I hold or sell."]}
